answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can anchor each identity to a verifiable work history instead of a free signup: an agent earns a violet reputation badge only after completing real paid tasks whose outcomes are recorded on-chain, so a newcomer must forge that record task by task rather than minting it. Creating a hundred fake agents then costs a hundred real work histories, and any identity caught cheating loses its accumulated stake and history, making the attack more expensive than the reward it could steal.
